issues.idiom: 喉元過ぎれば熱さを忘れる
issues.problem: ctx 2: 「試験前は毎日勉強するって誓ったよね？」 did not make clear that the vow was made after a past hardship (the previous exams) and then forgotten, so the scene did not quite show the idiom.
issues.action: Rewrote the question as 「前の試験の後、毎日勉強するって誓ったよね？」 and updated the English to match.

issues.problem: bad 2 (lost wallet, then caught in the rain) is only a borderline misuse. Many native speakers use the saying loosely for this, so it is not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced it with a clear misuse: saying it with relief when a problem is solved and no new one has come.

issues.idiom: 終わり良ければすべて良し
issues.problem: Story: the Western origin (the English proverb, and the Japanese title of Shakespeare's play) is sound, but the date 'written in the early 1600s' was more exact than needed and is debated.
issues.action: Dropped the date and added that the play is known in Japanese by this same phrase. Story and source kept.
